table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	InstallmentCode=IH.InstallmentCode,
	SaleInvCode = IH.SaleInvCode,
	Date = IH.Date,
	CustomerName = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE IH.CustCode = A.AccCode),
	ItemName = (SELECT I.Name FROM Item I WHERE IH.ICode = I.ICode),
	Qty = IH.Qty,
	ContractAmt = Round(Round((IH.qty * (IH.saleprice - IH.itemflatdisc) ) * (1 - IH.discperc * 0.01), 2)  + IH.markupamt + IH.processingfee, 0),
	UserName =(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=IH.UserCode),
	Remarks=IH.Remarks,
	Advance = ISNULL(IH.DownPayment,0),
	Installments = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISD.Amount) FROM InstallmentDetail ISD WHERE ISD.InstallmentCode = IH.InstallmentCode),0),
	NoOfInstallments = IH.NoOfInstallments,
	Approved = IH.Approved,
	ApprovedBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=IH.ApprovedBy),
	SalePerson = ISNULL((SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = IH.SManCode), '  <OTHERS> ')
FROM 
	InstallmentHeader IH
WHERE 
	IH.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	IH.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) OR IH.SManCode IS NULL
